subject.title: Add native macOS sharing for aggregate usage cards

question: Should CodexBar add a permanent native macOS Share action to the existing aggregate usage-card preview, or retain copy/save-only export?
rationale: This is a new user-facing sharing surface with platform integration and privacy/lifecycle expectations; the existing merged export feature does not by itself establish that native-service distribution is the intended product direction.

options.title: Approve native sharing
options.body: Add a Share action using the existing local aggregate payload and require focused file-representation tests plus freshly built bundle evidence.

options.title: Keep copy and save only
options.body: Preserve the current local export workflow and decline an additional macOS sharing surface for now.

recommendation.title: Approve native sharing
recommendation.body: Add a Share action using the existing local aggregate payload and require focused file-representation tests plus freshly built bundle evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged local share-card workflow and documented its privacy and export boundaries.
